story_sequence.text: Program-level governance resolves a lake to the aggregation branch from program/lake topology when `git-workflow-*.md` is absent.
Program-level governance still resolves through explicit `git-workflow-*.md` when present.
`beacon qa run <lake>` accepts the aggregation branch after workspace admission and does not block with `branch_alignment_required`.
Repos without program-level contract/topology continue to resolve `beacon/<version>/<feature-slug>`.
Soft admission still blocks wrong current branch with `branch_alignment_required` using the shared resolved target.

stories.text: Program-level governance resolves a lake to the aggregation branch from program/lake topology when `git-workflow-*.md` is absent.

Frozen program topology without `git-workflow-*.md` resolves lake `content-hub-foundation` to `branch_resolution_mode=program-level`, `feature_branch=beacon/v0.0.12`, and the program aggregation worktree.
Explicit `git-workflow-*.md` program-level contract continues to resolve the same aggregation branch/worktree.
`beacon qa run <lake>` passes workspace admission on `beacon/v0.0.12`; the controlled downstream block is `implementation_not_recorded`, not `branch_alignment_required`.
No program-level contract/topology keeps per-feature default `beacon/v9.9.9/demo-feature`.
`require_workspace_admission=false` on wrong current branch blocks with `branch_alignment_required` against aggregation target `beacon/v0.0.12`.
